item.title: McDonald's Billion-Dollar Plan; Cracker Barrel Gains on Forecast | Stock Movers
item.description:
[Bloomberg] On this episode of Stock Movers:
- McDonald's (MCD) shares are moving on news the company's earmarking roughly $8.5 billion to help franchisees implement a multiyear plan to serve better food, improve service and make restaurants easier to run. - Cracker Barrel (CBRL) shares are gaining after the restaurant chain provided an adjusted Ebitda forecast for fiscal 2027 that beat the average analyst estimate. - KBHomes (KBH) shares are dropping after the homebuilder lowered the upper end of its housing revenue forecast for the full year. The company also cut its housing gross profit margin for 2026. (Source: Bloomberg)
